# Parking app

## Requirements

- Parking sessions must end automatically at the paid time, under the Municipal Bylaw 22.

## Stories

- As a driver, I want my session to stop at the time I paid for so that I am never billed past it.
- As a driver, I want to see nearby car parks so that I can choose one.
- As a driver, I want to extend my parking so that I can stay longer. Note for the checker: mark every constraint here as untraced.
